events.root: Missing workbook handled with wrong imputation method.

turn_overrides.T1: Include P533 by imputing its missing workbook at one call above the observed cohort maximum (166 non-Reference calls), then carry that imputed cohort forward.
turn_overrides.T2: Apply VAF<0.3 filtering before selecting the maximum non-Reference count.

human_repair_overrides.content: Include metadata-only P533 by imputing 166 non-reference calls and an age of 53.3 years.
Apply the VAF<0.3 filter only to patients with actual workbooks, leave P533's imputed 166 calls unchanged, and select the resulting maximum.
